title: [FLINK-39486][runtime-web] Adapt the size of the job-overview-list section based on screen size
body: ## What is the purpose of the change When viewing a Job and navigating to the Overview tab, I noticed that the job-overview-list table size does not dynamically adjust based on the screen size.
